card.name: Linking words in ivermectin antiparasitic text
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, with, to and or, and partway through words, in label text about ivermectin and related antiparasitic drugs. The word usually comes right before the drug name or a dose term.

modes.label: Linking word before ivermectin
modes.description: The word 'of', 'with' or 'to' just before ivermectin, moxidectin or a dose in antiparasitic labeling.

modes.description: Partway through ivermectin or a drug-class word like antihelmintics, or a number in a tablet strength.

modes.description: The space after the word Table before a table number in an ivermectin dosing section.
